name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: GTM Enablement | Sales & CS Training, Playbooks, Onboarding Programs & Hands-On AI
summary: Go-to-market enablement builder with 15+ years across sales, onboarding, and customer success in B2B SaaS, so the playbooks I write come from having done the job. At Wix, built sales training for tenured account executives on a new product line that went from proof of concept to profitable, and helped hire, onboard, and train a team of 20. At Birdeye, built the automated product-training sequences that let 15-20 reseller partners sell and deploy without hand-holding, and ran a structured feedback loop to Product and Engineering. Ranked top three in sales at Accelo. Builds and evaluates AI agents and LLM workflows hands-on, so a technical AI product is something I can learn deeply and pitch myself.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Build reusable playbooks, templates, runbooks, and messaging frameworks so every engagement runs from a proven base instead of from scratch.
Architect and deploy AI agents and LLM workflows for clients, and built rubric-based evaluation of AI output to catch unreliable results before they ship.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' goals into precise AI agent instructions, the same translation between product capability and business outcome that enablement content requires.
Lead onboarding and hands-on training for every new client's technology stack, and write guides and educational content for non-technical users.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Coordinated execution across internal departments as strategic lead for multi-stakeholder accounts, driving alignment without direct authority.
Built campaign reporting frameworks and ran QBRs, translating performance data into recommendations.

experience.title: Partner Enablement & Onboarding (Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding)
bullets: Built automated product-training sequences and communication workflows that enabled 15-20 reseller partners to sell and deploy the product, retaining all but one (~94%).
Led onboarding and training for a diverse, high-volume partner network across health, home services, and retail.
Ran a structured feedback loop from partners and customers to Product and Engineering, prioritizing what the field needed on the roadmap.
Analyzed partner utilization data to find adoption gaps and target training where it would reduce churn.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Led the sales team while carrying a number, and built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and cross-team handoffs.

experience.title: Sales Enablement & Onboarding Team Lead (Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead)
bullets: Developed sales training for tenured account executives on a brand-new vertical that grew from proof of concept to a profitable business line.
Contributed to hiring, onboarding, and ramping new team members, and led and developed a team of onboarding specialists for two years (20, later 8).
Drove team initiatives and process improvements, standardizing CRM fields and workflows in Salesforce so the team worked from one shared framework.
Held 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets while launching 25+ clients per month.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled.
Built sequenced implementation plans and guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations alongside implementation teams.
